item.description:
Improved

  • Animate Dynamic Island expand and collapse transitions so shared icons and labels move directly into place, the shell springs smoothly, and header counts scale smoothly between states.
  • Choose a single display mode in Settings—Dynamic Island, Side Rail, Menu Bar, or Hide All—with the Dock icon available to reopen Settings when all surfaces are hidden.
  • Automatically refresh Claude usage when opening the menu panel with rate-limit protection, and merge official usage with status-line readings per billing window so idle sessions do not overwrite higher official readings.

Fixed

  • Fix square-corner clipping during Dynamic Island expansion and keep transitions smooth when expanding or collapsing again mid-animation.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
